evidence.detail: No test file for playability exists; decksite/data/playability.py has no corresponding test file
Full preaggregate pipeline with 12 functions covering legal cards, per-season counts, and cross-season aggregations — dense multi-step SQL with no test coverage

triage.notes: Requires a dummy DB fixture with ~10 cards, 3 archetypes, 3 seasons, plus running the full preaggregate chain and asserting on output values — non-trivial test infrastructure. The Kapsho Kitefins case and the #12323 all-time legality bug would be good primary test cases.
